The selected firm will be expected to provide structural engineering and design related services including, but not limited to, the preparation of bridge repair contracts, preliminary engineering, environmental studies, and final design of bridge repair, rehabilitation and replacement projects in accordance with FHWA, AASHTO, NBIS and PennDOT standards for all bridges located within the Township regardless of size and type

title: Rayne Township Municipal Engineer
short_description: Municipal engineering services for roadway and bridge studies, design, inspections, and construction support.
project_scope: Renewable 60-month municipal engineering assignment for Rayne Township covering studies, roadway design, bridge design, services during construction, NBIS bridge inspections, survey, right-of-way, construction management, and construction inspection. The selected firm is expected to provide structural engineering and design services for bridge repair contracts, preliminary engineering, environmental studies, and final design of bridge repair, rehabilitation, and replacement projects for all township bridges regardless of size and type, in accordance with FHWA, AASHTO, NBIS, and PennDOT standards.
services: Municipal engineering; roadway design; bridge design; structural engineering; bridge inspections (NBIS); preliminary engineering; environmental studies; survey; right-of-way services; construction management; construction inspection; bridge repair, rehabilitation, and replacement design.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes bridge design, rehabilitation, replacement, and structural engineering services, which are generally relevant to sbp.
- Covers all township bridges regardless of size and type, but no specific large spans or architecturally demanding structures are identified.
- Strong framework/on-call character as a renewable municipal engineer contract, which reduces attractiveness.
- Scope is broad and mixed with general municipal, roadway, inspection, and management tasks rather than focused on a specific complex structure.
- Could offer entry into bridge-related work, but technical ambition and project scale are unclear.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice is for an on-call municipal engineering services contract over a 60-month period covering multiple potential roadway and bridge tasks, including repair, rehabilitation, and replacement projects for township bridges. Because neither the number of bridges nor anticipated project sizes are given, a realistic total construction cost estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee or estimated contract value is stated in the source. The procurement appears to be a renewable 60-month municipal engineering services assignment with undefined task orders, so a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible without information on anticipated bridge projects, budgets, or compensation structure.
references_qualifications: Firms are expected to provide capabilities in civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, inspection services, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. The selected firm must be able to deliver bridge repair contracts, preliminary engineering, environmental studies, final design, and NBIS bridge inspections in accordance with FHWA, AASHTO, NBIS, and PennDOT standards.

notes: Project #865716; AgencyID 89992; ProjectID 1009157; DR #202600224922. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Contract duration: 60 months. Renewable: No. Solicitation documents available online.
